source_name: Shopify Community - Why is my Shopify analytics not working correctly?
quote_verbatim: there is still no resolution nearly 3 weeks later ... we're coming into the busiest time of the year now and can't trust any of the data

source_name: Shopify Community - Will Shopify's native Privacy & Compliance App support Google Consent Mode V2?
quote_verbatim: Shopify does not yet support Google Consent Mode v2 for Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics integrations. We are unable to state if and when Shopify will include support
summary_cs: Platforma potvrzuje, že consent mode v2 nepodporuje, měsíc před deadlinem Googlu. Doklad pro diferenciátor 'hlídáme deadliny platforem za klienta'.
notes: Citace odpovedi Shopify Support prevzata merchantem do vlakna
